misclassified_entities.reason: Contract callers (CALL/STATICCALL/DELEGATECALL) are internal EVM execution context. A contract calling another contract is part of the internal call stack within the EVM sandbox, not an external entity crossing a trust boundary.

The wallet user is the trust anchor, not an external entity to the wallet system. User approval is the final authorization gate - the user IS the trusted principal making decisions, not an untrusted external entity.

trusted_external_entities.name: Contract Deployer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity deploying contract bytecode via CREATE/CREATE2. Bytecode may be malicious or malformed. All EOF containers must undergo full validation: magic bytes (0xEF00), version byte, section ordering, type section size, code section counts, total size limits (MAX_INITCODE_SIZE), stray byte detection.

trusted_external_entities.name: Prospective Validator
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User submitting 32 ETH deposit to become a validator. Deposit data (pubkey, withdrawal credentials, signature) must be validated. No trust established until deposit is processed by beacon chain and stake is at risk.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Consensus client peer providing deposit tree snapshots. While part of the p2p network, snapshot data must be validated by recalculating deposit root from finalized hashes. Trust established via cryptographic verification, not implicit.

trusted_external_entities.name: Syncing Consensus Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Client performing weak subjectivity sync requesting deposit snapshots via /eth/v1/beacon/deposit_snapshot API. Has authenticated to the network but requests should still be rate-limited and responses should be consistent views.

trusted_external_entities.name: dApp Requesting Signature
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp requesting wallet_signIntendedValidatorData signature. May request signatures for malicious validators or fraudulent purposes. Validator address and data must be displayed to user for explicit approval.

trusted_external_entities.name: Signature Presenter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity presenting signature to validator contract for verification. May be attempting replay attacks or cross-validator signature reuse. Validator must reconstruct expected message with own address and verify via ecrecover.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Actor
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity attempting signature replay or cross-context reuse attacks. EIP-191 prefix (0x19 0x00 validatorAddress) prevents: (1) cross-validator reuse via different hash, (2) transaction replay via format mismatch.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain Validator (Attester)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Active validator creating attestations for beacon chain consensus. Has 32+ ETH at stake, authenticated via BLS signatures. Attestation data must still pass aggregation and verification rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer on gossip network, potentially malicious. May attempt gossip mutation attacks by modifying committee_bits during propagation. Pre-cache verification must confirm attester is actually in claimed committee before processing.

trusted_external_entities.name: dApp Requesting Chain Addition
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External application requesting wallet_addEthereumChain. May provide malicious chain config with incorrect chainId or untrusted RPC endpoints. All parameters must be validated and user must explicitly consent.

trusted_external_entities.name: Potentially Malicious dApp (Chain Addition)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: dApp attempting to add malicious chain configuration. May try: chainId spoofing, pointing to malicious RPC endpoints, leaking user activity/IP. Chain ID must be verified against RPC response, user must be warned about RPC exposure risks.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Bytecode from deployer is untrusted. Must validate: magic bytes 0xEF00, version byte (0x01 not 0x00), section order (type, code, [container], data, terminator), type_size divisible by 4, at least 1 code section with size >= 1, total size <= MAX_INITCODE_SIZE (49152), no stray bytes.

Deposit from prospective validator is untrusted until processed. Deposit contract validates signature. Consensus clients add to Merkle tree. Deposit not finalized until eth1_data finalized AND deposit_index >= deposit_count.

Snapshot from peer requires validation. Must recalculate deposit root from finalized hashes and compare to transmitted deposit_root. Root mismatch indicates corrupted or malicious snapshot - reject and do not reconstruct tree.
Syncing client requests snapshot via /eth/v1/beacon/deposit_snapshot. Response must be consistent view at finalized point, not in-progress state. Rate limiting recommended to prevent DoS.

Signing request from dApp is untrusted. Must parse and validate parameters, display validator address and data to user, require explicit user approval before constructing message (0x19 || 0x00 || validatorAddress || dataToSign) and signing.

Signature presenter may attempt replay. Validator must: reconstruct message using OWN address (not claimed validator), hash reconstructed message, ecrecover signer, compare recovered vs claimed address. Different validator address produces different hash, blocking cross-validator reuse.
Validator creates attestation with index=0 in signed data (EIP-7549). Must sign AttestationData, committee index in outer container only. Enables cross-committee aggregation with 62x fewer pairings.

P2P peer may attempt gossip mutation by modifying committee_bits. Pre-cache verification required: confirm attester is actually in claimed committee using committee_bits before storing or forwarding. Invalid membership = gossip mutation attack, reject attestation.

Chain addition request is untrusted. Must validate: chainId is valid hex (EIP-155), rpcUrls non-empty with HTTPS scheme, query eth_chainId on RPC endpoints and compare to submitted chainId, validate nativeCurrency if provided. Require explicit user consent with dApp identity displayed.

Potentially malicious chain config. Security measures: (1) use only submitted chainId for signing (never trust RPC-reported ID), (2) warn user that activity/IP exposed to RPC endpoints, (3) require explicit user consent, (4) identify requesting dApp origin. Reject file:/http: schemes.

coverage_gaps: EXT-CALLER - Reclassified as internal EVM execution context
EXT-USER - Reclassified as trust anchor, not external entity
coverage_analysis.note: EXT-CALLER (contract callers) and EXT-USER (wallet user) reclassified as internal/trust-anchor respectively. Remaining 11 external entities have corresponding boundary edges with security assumptions.
